categories: Capture leads, qualify opportunities, and prepare proposals.
Prepare invoices, match payments, and flag overdue balances.
Track renewals, onboarding, and the next useful conversation.
Prepare content, organize campaigns, and respond to feedback.
Coordinate schedules, documents, inventory, and project updates.
Turn meetings, forms, and documents into organized work.

items.title: Route website leads
items.before: A website inquiry waits to be copied into the CRM.
items.prepare: Extract the contact, project, and requested service.
items.review: Check the new record and assigned owner.

items.title: Prepare a proposal
items.before: A new proposal starts with a blank document.
items.prepare: Draft a scope from the brief and approved service templates.
items.review: Review scope, exclusions, and pricing before sharing.

items.title: Find relevant tenders
items.before: Someone checks procurement portals one at a time.
items.prepare: Collect opportunities and compare them with your criteria.
items.review: Choose the opportunities worth pursuing.

items.title: Coordinate discovery calls
items.before: The team compares calendars by hand.
items.prepare: Find available slots and prepare an invitation.
items.review: Confirm the time and invitation details.

items.title: Prepare invoices from completed work
items.before: Completed jobs wait for someone to build the invoice.
items.prepare: Match approved milestones with billing details.
items.review: Check amounts and tax treatment before issuing.

items.title: Match payments to invoices
items.before: Payments and invoice records need manual comparison.
items.prepare: Suggest matches and separate uncertain transactions.
items.review: Confirm matches and investigate exceptions.

items.title: Track overdue balances
items.before: An overdue balance gets lost in a spreadsheet.
items.prepare: Group overdue invoices and prepare follow-up tasks.
items.review: Review the account context before contacting clients.

items.title: Build a cash collection report
items.before: The weekly collections report takes an afternoon.
items.prepare: Compile aging balances and highlight changes.
items.review: Verify the source totals before sharing the report.

items.title: Prepare renewal check-ins
items.before: Contract dates live in scattered documents.
items.prepare: Extract renewal dates and prepare check-in tasks.
items.review: Choose the right timing and message for each client.

items.title: Coordinate client onboarding
items.before: People chase the same intake details repeatedly.
items.prepare: Organize submitted files and flag missing information.
items.review: Confirm readiness before starting delivery.

items.title: Spot accounts needing attention
items.before: Support patterns are hard to see across accounts.
items.prepare: Summarize recurring issues and changes in activity.
items.review: Decide which clients need a personal conversation.

items.title: Prepare account review briefs
items.before: An account manager gathers context from several tools.
items.prepare: Summarize recent work, feedback, and open commitments.
items.review: Check the brief before the client meeting.

items.title: Adapt content for each channel
items.before: One useful idea is rewritten for every platform.
items.prepare: Prepare channel-specific drafts from an approved source.
items.review: Review the voice and facts before publication.

items.title: Prepare review responses
items.before: Customer reviews wait for someone to reply.
items.prepare: Draft a response using approved guidance and context.
items.review: Approve public replies; handle sensitive cases personally.

items.title: Build campaign reports
items.before: Someone copies figures from several dashboards.
items.prepare: Combine campaign metrics and flag missing inputs.
items.review: Validate attribution and numbers before drawing conclusions.

items.title: Organize creative assets
items.before: Approved files are hard to find across folders.
items.prepare: Suggest tags, names, and a calendar slot for each asset.
items.review: Confirm rights, version, and publication timing.

items.title: Schedule jobs and resources
items.before: Dispatch compares crew availability and job details.
items.prepare: Suggest slots based on location, skills, and duration.
items.review: Confirm the schedule before notifying the team.

items.title: Extract information from PDFs
items.before: Order details are copied from documents one field at a time.
items.prepare: Extract quantities, dates, and references into a draft record.
items.review: Check uncertain fields against the source document.

items.title: Flag inventory shortages
items.before: Low stock is discovered just before a job starts.
items.prepare: Compare stock with upcoming demand and flag shortages.
items.review: Review purchase suggestions before placing orders.

items.title: Prepare project status updates
items.before: Project updates are scattered across notes and task boards.
items.prepare: Compile milestones, blockers, and upcoming handoffs.
items.review: Confirm the report before it reaches the client.

items.title: Turn meeting notes into tasks
items.before: Meeting decisions stay buried in a transcript.
items.prepare: Extract actions, owners, and proposed due dates.
items.review: Confirm commitments before creating assigned tasks.

items.title: Process supplier documents
items.before: Supplier bills need manual entry and checking.
items.prepare: Extract bill details and compare against purchase orders.
items.review: Approve exceptions and payment separately.

items.title: Find answers in internal documents
items.before: People ask colleagues where the latest policy lives.
items.prepare: Find relevant passages and draft an answer with sources.
items.review: Check the cited source before acting on sensitive guidance.

items.title: Prepare team handovers
items.before: A handover depends on someone remembering every detail.
items.prepare: Gather active work, deadlines, and unresolved decisions.
items.review: Confirm ownership and context before handing over.
